lines.q: Thirty-five spooky questions. If you get twenty-five right, you're a true Halloween expert. Which TV family has a butler named Lurch?
What does a witch traditionally ride?
Which monster is wrapped in bandages?
How many legs does a spider have?
In The Wizard of Oz, which witch melts?
lines.a: The Wicked Witch of the West! I'm melting!

lines.q: Which nineteen eighty-four film asks: Who you gonna call?
Which fruit do people bob for at Halloween?
Which food is said to keep vampires away?
In which TV show are Herman and Lily married?
Who wrote Doctor Jekyll and Mister Hyde?
Who wrote both It and Carrie?
Which nineteen seventy-three film features a possessed girl named Regan?
Which nineteen sixty-three Hitchcock film has attacking birds?
Which Shakespeare play opens with three witches?
lines.a: Macbeth! Double, double, toil and trouble.

lines.q: Who painted The Scream?
The Day of the Dead is most famous in which country?
Who wrote The Hound of the Baskervilles?
lines.a: Arthur Conan Doyle! A Sherlock Holmes story.

lines.q: Who wrote The Invisible Man in eighteen ninety-seven?
lines.a: H. G. Wells! If you're enjoying this, subscribe and turn on the bell!

lines.q: Monster Mash hit number one in which year?
The Shining is set in which hotel?
What is the fear of spiders called?
Which spider is named after the female sometimes eating the male?
What giant monster attacks New York in Ghostbusters?
Which nineteen sixty-eight horror film stars Mia Farrow?
Who played Dracula in the Hammer films from nineteen fifty-eight?
Which flower decorates Day of the Dead altars?
lines.a: The marigold! Its orange guides the spirits.

lines.q: What is the vampire called in Nosferatu, from nineteen twenty-two?
Who wrote the ghost story The Turn of the Screw?
The aye-aye is seen as a bad omen in which country?
lines.a: Madagascar! A lemur with a long, spooky finger.

lines.q: Which silent film star was the Man of a Thousand Faces?
Who played Van Helsing opposite Christopher Lee?
Who wrote the novel The Phantom of the Opera?
Which seventeen sixty-four book is called the first Gothic novel?
lines.a: The Castle of Otranto! By Horace Walpole.

lines.q: What is a Day of the Dead sugar skull called?
Final question. Who directed The Nightmare Before Christmas?
lines.a: Henry Selick! Not Tim Burton. Burton produced it.
